summary: Frontend-only redesign verification (Neo-Brutalism). All 11 requested flows pass on preview URL. Nav: Boutique/Événements/Commandes/Messages/Admin only — no per-game nav entries. Home sections (hero, home-game-selection, popular-grid, home-steps, home-why with 4 cards, home-faq with 4 items + accordion expand) all render. Game card home-game-pubg-mobile navigates to /boutique?game=pubg-mobile. /boutique with no game shows game-picker. Catalog product cards render without the old game-icon thumbnail (0 imgs on cards); price/add-to-cart/badges show; type-tab-all/type-tab-evo/catalog-search/sort-select present and functional (bogus search returns 0). Add to cart updates cart-count to 1. Login with admin@magicgame.store redirects to '/'. /admin dashboard shows admin-dashboard and NO payment providers block. /admin/paiements shows admin-payments with mobile section (papi-auto-toggle, fiveone-toggle, payment-fees-setting) and Binance (admin-payments-binance + admin-binance). /admin/paiements/binance redirects to /admin/paiements. Admin catalogue has admin-game-tabs with 2 game tabs, admin-catalog-search, and admin-new-product opens the dialog pre-set to 'PUBG Mobile'. No raw API-key/secret values are exposed in plain-text inputs.
